RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Thunderfall
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Choose a visible position within 24 cells. Lightning strikes immediately, then every 0.5 seconds for 3 waves total. Each wave deals 225 + 25 × chain levels damage to up to 16 enemies within a 6-cell radius.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Worldfire field
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Choose a visible position within 20 cells. Burns immediately, then every 1 second for 6 waves total. Each wave deals 160 + 30 × burn levels damage to up to 16 enemies within a 6-cell radius.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Crimson sovereign
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Deal 250 + 35 × health multiplier damage to up to 16 enemies within 10 cells of the caster, heal the caster for 200 points and grant a 400-point shield for 12 seconds.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Earthshatter
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Stomp up to 16 enemies within 8 cells of the caster for 300 + 80 × health multiplier damage and stun them for 2 seconds.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Absolute zero
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Choose a visible position within 22 cells. Deal 240 + 40 × frost levels damage to up to 16 enemies within a 7-cell radius, stun them for 3 seconds and slow them for 8 seconds.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Bladestorm
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Lock onto a visible enemy within 24 cells. Strike immediately, then every 0.2 seconds for 6 hits total. Each deals 125 + 40 × damage bonus multiplier damage. If the target dies or moves more than 4 cells from its starting position, pursue the nearest enemy in that area.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Starpiercer
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Fire a piercing arrow 36 cells long and 3 cells wide in the chosen direction. Up to 16 visible enemies in its path each take 600 + 300 × long-range bonus multiplier damage.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Night procession
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Choose a visible position within 24 cells. Release souls immediately, then every 1 second for 3 waves total. Each wave strikes the nearest 6 enemies within an 8-cell radius for 160 + 4 × effective soul marks damage each. Does not consume soul marks. The first 100 soul marks count fully, with diminishing returns thereafter; stored counts are preserved.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Prismatic sanctuary
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Grant all free colonists within 12 cells shields of 500 + 40 × the caster's health multiplier for 12 seconds, and heal each for 80 points. Can protect downed colonists. Refreshes keep the stronger shield of this type.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Golden decree
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Deliver 1,200 silver and 40 gold near the caster. Only usable at a player home. Shares a 1-day colony-wide cooldown. Autocast uses one colonist capable of acting.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Industrial overdrive
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Overload all free colonists on the map at the time of casting. Global work speed is multiplied by 4; research, mining and plant work speeds are multiplied by another 4, for a final ×16. Lasts 1 game hour. Home maps only; shares a 6-game-hour colony-wide cooldown.

RimHex.HexSkillDef.label: Song of life
RimHex.HexSkillDef.description: Heal all free colonists on the caster's map for 300 points each, including downed colonists. Shares a 120-second colony-wide cooldown. Only heals treatable injuries; cannot resurrect or regrow missing parts.

HediffDef.label: Path abilities
HediffDef.description: Signature abilities unlocked by base evolutions. Hover to see cooldowns. Configure autocast in the build panel.

HediffDef.label: Industrial overdrive
HediffDef.description: Global work speed ×4; research, mining and plant work speeds ×16 in total. Removed when the duration expires or the Industry path becomes dormant.
